newsitems.title: 🎉 A few days into Early Access: Recap and a big Thank you!
newsitems.author: Jasmin
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hey everyone! 🏰
[/p][p]Short update before the weekend as we’re still taking it all in. A few days after launch, [b]more than 150,000[/b] of you have picked up Wanderburg in the first three days, [b]over 800 streamers[/b] have jumped into the game, and we [b]peaked at 9.9K players online at once yesterday[/b]. That’s a pretty incredible start, and we’re very happy to see so many of you exploring Wanderburg with us.[/p][p] [/p][p]We've been spending a lot of time reading your feedback and bug reports, checking out your crazy builds and highscore chases, and were happy to see so many kind messages being directed towards us. We’re also keeping a close eye on your Steam reviews, which are a huge help in understanding what’s working, what could be better, and where we should take Wanderburg next.[/p][p] [/p][p]Of course, the journey hasn’t been completely smooth. Performance isn’t where we want it to be yet, and we’re working on it. You’ve also given us plenty of feedback on things you’d like to see in the future, from new features and adjustments to meta progression and more. There’s still a lot to do, but we’re excited about what’s ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Most importantly, thank you for your patience, your feedback, and your support. And to everyone who joined us for the first time with the Early Access launch this week: welcome! We’re very happy to have you here.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful to have so many of you along for the ride, and we can’t wait to keep building on Wanderburg together over the coming months.[/p][p] [/p][p]Es gibt nur eine Burg![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Team Randwerk & Sidekick [b]🧡[/b][/p]

newsitems.title: Achievement Rebalancing
newsitems.author: Langer Toast
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]Now that we have better statistics from all of you playing, we took some time to rebalance our stats-based achivements, so that you don't have to grind quite as hard. We also changed the naming convention of the "distance travelled" achievements to meters, because that's what we're actually tracking (we kept kilometers in the description)[/p][p][/p][p] The changes are: 
 [/p][p][b]Distance Travelled:[/b][/p][p]Tier 1: 10km (10.000m)
Tier 2: 100km (100.000m)
Tier 3: [strike]1000km[/strike] > 250km(250.000m)
Tier 4: [strike]5000km[/strike] > 500km(500.000m)
Tier 5: [strike]10.000km[/strike] > 1000km(1000.000m)

[b]Bosses killed:[/b][/p][p]Tier 1: 10
Tier 2: 25
Tier 3: 50
Tier 4: [strike]100[/strike] > 75
Tier 5: [strike]500[/strike] > 100

[b]Units consumed:[/b][/p][p]Tier 1: 1000
Tier 2: 5000
Tier 3: [strike]10.000[/strike] > 7.500
Tier 4: [strike]50.000[/strike] > 10.000
Tier 5: [strike]100.000[/strike] > 25.000

There still remains the issue of "You Won!" and "All Biomes Won!" only being checked when you don't go into overtime when you win - we will fix this in the coming update, but still need to test if that build is safe. Be assured your progress is saved, and the achivement will be triggered in the future

Es gibt nur eine Burg.
- Johannes from Randwerk[/p]

newsitems.title: Wanderburg, a bullet heaven where you drive around a Frankensteinian hybrid of a castle and a tank, is out in early access today
newsitems.contents:
Truth be told, I'm still not sold on "bullet heaven" as a genre. Name notwithstanding, the genre is certainly here to stay, and there always seems to be funny new takes on it despite the fact that Vampire Survivors did kind of start it off without much room for improvement. While I'm not sure if Wanderburg is an improvement (I haven't played it yet), I do conceptually like its approach being to hand you a modular medieval castle tank that can suck up sheep and blast cannon fire at your enemies. And it's out today in early access!

Read more

newsitems.title: Wanderburg is OUT NOW! 🏰🐑
newsitems.author: Jasmin
newsitems.contents: [p]We can finally let you explore what we’ve been working on at full force. The game has come a long way since the early playtests and demo and we think you’ll be surprised by how much has changed. We can’t wait to see your crazy builds, watch your runs, and see who takes over the leaderboards![/p][p][/p][h3]A massive thank you to our community, playtesters, creators, families, and friends who supported us along the way. You are the best! [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="J_4-TAOy1lA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning for us. We want to hear all your feedback and read your Steam reviews as we keep working on new content. Stay tuned, because we’ll be sharing an [b]Early Access roadmap[/b] with you soon! [/p][p]We will also be retiring our Steam demo today. As we mentioned, the game has changed so much since March that the demo just doesn't represent the game we are releasing into early access today. We hope the impressions and videos you'll see coming up from our community will be convincing enough to know Wanderburg is as exciting, whimsical and fun as we wanted it to be.[/p][p][/p][p]Greetings from Berlin,[/p][p]Randwerk, Sidekick, and everyone who worked on and supported the development 🧡[/p]

newsitems.title: SURPRISE UPDATE: NEW CAPTAIN AVAILABLE NOW & easy ways to support us
newsitems.author: vanHarten
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hi everyone, we have a little surprise for you!
[/p][h2][b]SURPRISE UPDATE: NEW CAPTAIN AVAILABLE NOW![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Meet our newest and probably least qualified captain: [/p][h2][b]Dieter the Drunk 🍺[/b][/h2][p]Dieter very much enjoys his "Feierabendbier" (or multiple of them) and drives in beautiful zig zag lines. He has a very unique sense of direction and somehow deals more damage while doing so.  [/p][p][/p][p]He is our challenge to all of you who have already mastered the demo and wanted something a bit different. [/p][p]  [/p][h2][b]Support us: Steam Reviews and Wishlists[/b][/h2][p] If you are enjoying the demo, please consider leaving an honest[b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268810/Wanderburg_Demo/"]Steam review on our demo page[/url][/b]. [/p][p]And obligatory: Do not forget to [b]wishlist Wanderburg[/b]!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/"][/dynamiclink]
Reviews and wishlists genuinely help us more than you might think. Visibility, reach, algorithm magic. It makes a huge difference for a small team like ours.

[/p][h2][b]LAST CHANCE: Win 1 of 100 Wanderburg Steam Keys![/b][/h2][p]If you have not participated yet, you [b]only have time until MONDAY[/b]. [/p][p]And honestly, we do not have that many participants yet. [/p][p]Your chance to win is not small!
[/p][p]How to join [/p][p]• Complete the demo with 3 different captains [/p][p]• Follow the instructions in [url="https://discord.gg/KKjWpyttsK"]our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Over 100,000 Demo Players[/b][/h2][p]That number is absolutely insane to us.[/p][p]❤️ [b]Thank you so much[/b] for your time, excitement, feedback, streams, videos, chaos, all of it ❤️ [/p][p][/p][p]Seeing so many of you play Wanderburg means the world to us.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Alright. 
Now go try Dieter the Drunk.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Marco from Randwerk[/p]

newsitems.title: Wanderburg Demo Live Now! & 100 key raffle
newsitems.author: vanHarten
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello everyone, the wait is finally over!

[h2][b]The official Wanderburg demo is live right now![/b][/h2]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268810/Wanderburg_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
We’ve gathered all your valuable feedback from our December playtest and have been working tirelessly to turn those insights into meaningful improvements across the entire game. 
A lot has changed since you last saw us, and we can't wait for you to experience this new version of Wanderburg.


[h2][b]Win 1 of 100 WANDERBURG Steam Keys![/b][/h2]
To celebrate the launch, we’re hosting a [b]special challenge until March 2nd[/b]: 
- [b]Complete the demo with 3 different captains[/b] to receive a personal code to participate 
- How to enter: [url=https://discord.gg/7js3NsUwzS][b]Join our Discord[/b][/url] and check out the #demo-raffle channel.


[h2][b]Your Feedback Shapes Wanderburg[/b][/h2]
Your thoughts mean everything to us. As a small studio, we read every single bit of feedback to help shape the future development of our game.
If you enjoy the demo, [b]please consider leaving a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268810/Wanderburg_Demo/]review on our Steam Demo page[/url][/b]. This helps us a lot more than you think!
[b]Report Bugs/Feedback[/b]: [b]Use the in-game feedback form or join our Discord[/b] to share detailed thoughts.


[h2][b]And don't forget to WISHLIST Wanderburg[/b][/h2]
Help us make our numbers go brrrrrrrrrrrr, it helps us a lot!


[h2][b]Joining forces with Sidekick Publishing[/b][/h2]
We are also excited to announce our official partnership with our fellow Berlin-based friends, Sidekick Publishing. They are helping us make Wanderburg even better!


[b]Start your engines and play the WANDERBURG demo now![/b]
- Marco from Randwerk


 And if you enjoy roguelike games, check out the fantastic demo of Gambonanza as well:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509230/Gambonanza/"][/dynamiclink]

newsitems.title: Thank You for Playing the Wanderburg Playtest - Demo coming in February
newsitems.author: vanHarten
newsitems.contents:
[p]Today our first public playtest is coming to an end, and we want to say a huge thank you to everyone who took part.

[b]Over 126,000 players[/b] jumped into Wanderburg during the playtest. That number still feels a bit unreal to us, and we’re incredibly grateful for the time, feedback, bug reports, and enthusiasm you shared with us. [/p][p][/p][p]We also want to [b]wish everyone a great holiday break[/b]. We’ll be taking a few days off ourselves to recharge, since this playtest has been quite intense for us. Then we’ll be back at it with a clear head.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ll return with a new, improved DEMO build with more content in February for the Steam Next Fest.[/b]  
Don’t forget to [b]wishlist and follow Wanderburg[/b] to get a notification when it goes live:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you again for supporting Wanderburg so early on. We’re excited to show you what’s next.

– Marco from Randwerk
[/p]

newsitems.title: Wanderburg Playtest Extended by One Week! Thank You Everyone
newsitems.author: vanHarten
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Hi, we want to give a huge thank you to all of you who joined our first public playtest![/b][/h2]

We were incredibly surprised by how many players showed up, and many of you are still playing right now. (We had a player peak of almost 1900, absolute madness!)

[b]Your feedback has been incredibly valuable. [/b]
We’re already fixing bugs, improving systems and making adjustments based on what you’ve shared with us. And it helps us a lot with the direction going forward as well.

Because of your excitement and support, [b]we’re extending the playtest by a full week[/b]. We want to give you more time to enjoy Wanderburg and give ourselves more space to improve the game with your insights.
Afterwards the playtest will go offline and we'll prepare a demo with lots of new content (and less bugs) for the Steam Next Fest in February 2026!

[b]If you’d like to stay involved with development, [url=https://discord.gg/Y3ANY683ag]join our community on Discord[/url][/b]. 
We’re running a [b]Steam Key Giveaway[/b] there as a thank you to our early supporters. (Check out the announcement post!)

And don't forget to wishlist & follow Wanderburg if you haven't yet!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/

Thank you again for making this first playtest such a success and for the love you've shown towards Wanderburg. It means everything to us.

- Marco from Randwerk
